The '''Maximum Security Section''' was one of the main districts of the [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. MaxSec also made use of the cave complex known as the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]], though the caverns were not considered part of the district proper.

==Behind the scenes==
The Maximum Security Section first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
